bundledDataset.contents: Arabic Quran text and Sahih International English translation for 114 surahs / 6236 ayahs
bundledDataset.historicalUpstream: The original import commit did not record a source. A complete comparison on 2026-10-08 established that every bundled Arabic ayah matches AlQuran Cloud edition quran-uthmani and every bundled translation matches edition en.sahih after the documented presentation normalization.
bundledDataset.certificationStatus: Exact full-dataset provider match verified; not independently scholarly certified
bundledDataset.role: Offline fallback and immutable integrity anchor for runtime network/cache validation
bundledDataset.normalization: Rows serialized as surah:ayah:NFC Arabic after BOM removal, whitespace normalization, and Nuur's first-ayah Bismillah presentation rule, joined with LF

verificationEvidence.scope: This proves exact agreement with the named provider datasets on the verification date. It is not a claim of independent scholarly certification.

runtimeVerseSource.acceptancePolicy: Exact edition identifiers, surah count/order/schema, Arabic equality, and Sahih International translation equality with the bundled integrity anchor
runtimeVerseSource.licensingStatus: Provider software repository is GPL-3.0; redistribution terms for the Quran/translation dataset itself were not clearly established by that repository and require release-owner review

runtimeWordSource.role: Optional word-by-word display; never replaces the primary Arabic verse text

releaseRequirement: Confirm Quran text, Sahih International translation, word-data, and audio redistribution/attribution terms before public release. Never imply this manifest or provider comparison is independent scholarly certification.
